Achrista Bynon December 6, 2025 The overall transformation and quality from Renovation by Burbach looks phenomenal when comparing how the house was before to how it is now. The existing material was starting to rot, paint was peeling off, and other areas seemed like it was starting to fall apart (the house is over 100 years old). Removing some of the old material and replacing the whole exterior with new material, we feel confident that the house will last for many years to come (structurally and aesthetically). There was a line of communication via group text between me and my husband (homeowners), Chris (sales/design consultant), Jason (operations manager), and Jay (project manager/foreman). Jay was quite friendly and understanding while coordinating with us and the installers. Chris was clear on going over everything at the start of the project, any change orders, and any communication all the way until the end of the project. If you are doing a renovation, be aware of any pre-existing conditions that may come up that couldn’t be seen prior to demolition of removing old existing material. Our house had some rotting wood and water damage under some of the exterior materials. There wasn’t enough contingency in the estimate to replace the damaged materials, so it resulted in a change order. It is best if you are as specific as possible and know exactly what you want at the beginning to avoid any change orders. Provide any sketches or drawing layout ideas you may have (send through group text and/or email). When you do a walk through at the start of the project, I recommend to send them a follow-up text or email of any final decisions that were made to confirm any verbal decisions. For our project, there was a misunderstanding about the door trim. We envisioned the door trim to be the full length of the door while they envisioned the trim only running down to the stone sills (most likely a misunderstanding from a verbal miscommunication error). We provided exterior elevation drawings showing that the door trim is the same length as the doors (while window trim only went down to the stone sills). Even though they had to make some adjustments (cutting some of the stone back after it was installed), they honored the style we were looking for. There was a minor issue with a new window (wrong style and it was damaged), but they were able to replace and install a different new window with no hesitations. They took the time to properly fix existing damages, installing waterproof barrier, sealing the holes (from staples), installing lath, water runnoffs, scratch coat, mortar, stone, stucco, aluminium trim (soffit and facia), and James Hardie trim (around doors and windows). Keep in mind, your site project is not their only project (same goes for any renovation company). With that being said, the project took longer than anticipated. It was estimated to take about a month and it took closer to five months. We appreciate that it wasn’t a rush job (we’re not going anywhere seems how we already live in the house) and anyone on site appeared to take pride in their work. However, it would’ve been better if we knew what days they plan / don’t plan on being here (other than just regular weekend off time and possible bad weather) - or at least a weekly update. There were times when there wasn’t anyone here for a few days to a whole week. Other times, there’d be only one person here for a couple of hours. Besides that, there were days where they were here for majority of the day and got a decent amount of work done. Eventually, we plan on building a detached garage and we’d like to have Renovation by Burbach take on the exterior finishes to match the house. The duration of a siding installation project varies based on the size of your home and the type of siding being installed. A complete installation can typically take a few days to a couple of weeks. Well-installed, quality siding can significantly improve your home’s insulation, potentially lowering energy costs by keeping your home warmer in the winter and cooler in the summer. This is especially important in Utah’s diverse climate. How Do I Know If I Need Siding Repair or a Full Replacement? Visible signs such as warping, rotting, or energy inefficiency can indicate the need for siding repair or replacement. It’s best to consult professionals like Renovation By Burbach to assess the condition of your existing siding and recommend the most suitable solution. Is Siding Installation Possible During Winter? Renovation By Burbach is equipped to handle Utah’s winter conditions to ensure your siding installation is successful, regardless of the season. Can soffit and fascia improve energy efficiency? Absolutely. Properly installed soffit enhances airflow into the attic or ceiling space, which reduces heat buildup and lowers cooling costs. Combined with insulated fascia materials, these components contribute to a more energy-efficient and comfortable commercial environment. How do I know if my soffit and fascia need to be replaced? Signs that you may need replacement include peeling paint, sagging boards, mold or mildew growth, visible water damage, or critters getting into your roofline. Frequently Asked Questions About Windows & Doors How do I know which type of window is best for my home? Here’s the thing. There’s no one size fits all answer. The right window depends on your home’s style, how exposed it is to Utah weather, your energy efficiency goals, and your budget. During your consultation, we walk you through materials, styles, and performance differences so you understand the pros and cons before making a decision. The goal isn’t to upsell. It’s to find what actually fits your home and how you live in it. Are your windows energy efficient? Yes. All of our windows meet or exceed ENERGY STAR® standards. What this really means is better insulation, fewer drafts, more consistent indoor temperatures, and lower energy bills over time. In Utah’s climate, that matters. Especially during hot summers and cold winters when inefficient windows can drive up costs fast. Can I mix window styles or materials in my home? Absolutely, and it’s more common than you might think. Many homeowners mix materials or styles based on exposure, design goals, or specific rooms. For example, one style on the front for curb appeal and another in the back for function. Our job is to make sure everything still looks cohesive and intentional, not pieced together. Do new windows really increase home value? Yes, especially when done correctly. Updated windows improve curb appeal, boost energy efficiency, and signal to buyers that the home has been cared for. While every market is different, window replacement consistently ranks as a strong return-on-investment upgrade for Utah homeowners (and it often ties into bigger exterior upgrades like siding). If you’re thinking about resale impact, this is worth reading: exterior projects that offer the best payback . How long does window or door installation take?
